title: Quiz: justify-content or align-items?
why_it_matters: Mixing up the two flexbox alignment properties costs beginners hours.
explanation: Flexbox has a main axis and a cross axis. justify-content works along the main axis. align-items works along the cross axis. By default the main axis is horizontal, but flex-direction: column flips both of them.
try_it: Quiz: after adding flex-direction: column, which property now centers items left to right? (Answer: align-items.)
